title: PSRV S.A. Agulhas II full-scale level-ice trial (Baltic Sea, 21-22 March 2012): recorded speed vs measured thickness

ship.name: S.A. Agulhas II (polar supply & research vessel, PC 5)
ship.source: Aalto thesis Table 3 (length/breadth/draught/displacement); bow and flare angles are ASSUMED default values (not reported) -- this series is therefore screening-only

provenance.citation: Aalto University doctoral thesis, 'Evaluation of selected state-of-the-art methods for ship performance in level ice' (Table 3, Table 4, Sec. 2.4); measurements from the S.A. Agulhas II ice trial reported by Suominen et al. (2013) and Bekker et al. (2014)
provenance.retrieval_note: Full-text extract of the thesis retrieved from AaltoDspace on 2026-11-10 (the repository's text bitstream, not the publisher PDF). Per-case engine power is not tabulated; the source reports only the 2000-5400 kW range across the four level-ice periods.
limitations: no measured thrust/resistance: adjudication is a power-band consistency screen only
hull bow angle and flare not reported -> assumed; used only for screening
ice rubble contamination in case (d) (source notes speed drops from rubble)
